about_the_game:
Welcome to a world where strategy meets instinct—this is not just a card game, nor a simple block-matching puzzle, but a journey shaped by choice, rhythm, and fate.

Remnants of Sin is a roguelike strategy game that blends deck-building mechanics with block-matching combat. You play as a wanderer caught between sin and redemption, constructing unique decks and planning your moves to defeat enemies of all forms. Every battle, every decision, will lead your journey down a different path.

Core Features:

  • Deck-Building and Chain Strategy: Combine skills and effects freely to craft your own combat rhythm.

  • Block-Matching Combat System: Balance strategy and reaction, turning every move into a chance to change the tide.

  • Random Events and Relic System: Discover unexpected powers throughout your endless adventure.

  • High Replayability: Each run tells a different story of fate.

This is only the beginning—experience the core systems and battle mechanics in this Demo, and catch a glimpse of the full adventure to come.

short_description: Experience a fresh fusion of block elimination and deck-building. Become a powerful hero seeking redemption, travel the world to slay corrupted demons, and forge unstoppable deck and relic combos to break every chain that stands in your way.
